revenue_scope: Worldwide (US + Intl) 'OTHER ONCOLOGY' line of J&J's Oncology franchise, a residual line that holds DOXIL/CAELYX from 2013Q1 together with other oncology products.
why_separate: J&J stopped printing a DOXIL/CAELYX line after 2012Q4 and reports the product only inside OTHER ONCOLOGY, a residual line that also holds other products and changes composition over time. It is a broader line, not Doxil's own sales.
notes: Span 2013Q1-2018Q4. The line is carried only to 2018Q4: Baxter's FY2020 Form 10-K states 'We previously acquired the U.S. rights to this product in 2019' and its FY2021 Form 10-K dates the ex-U.S. acquisition from a J&J subsidiary to 2021-02-17, but no J&J 10-K or 10-Q filed 2019-02 to 2020-10 mentions DOXIL (0 hits, measured), so the quarter in which the U.S. sales left OTHER ONCOLOGY is not documented and later quarters are not claimed to hold the product. Composition of the line as J&J's own later schedules show it: (1) IMBRUVICA was inside the line until the 2015Q1 schedule gave it its own line; that schedule restates 2014Q1 OTHER ONCOLOGY from the 102 printed in 2014Q1 to 92, the difference being the IMBRUVICA prior-year figure of 10 printed on the same schedule, and its supplemental table gives IMBRUVICA 2014 quarters 10, 42, 56, 92. The 2013Q1-2014Q4 rows are as first printed (including IMBRUVICA from its launch; 2013Q4 is not restated anywhere, so how much of it is IMBRUVICA is not measured). (2) DARZALEX was inside the line from its launch until the 2016Q4 schedule gave it its own line (prior-year 2015Q4 DARZALEX 20; 2015Q4 OTHER ONCOLOGY restated from 136 to 116). The 2015Q4 row is as first printed (136, including DARZALEX). 2016Q1-2016Q3 were first printed as 231, 236 and 282 including DARZALEX; those three rows are taken from the 2017 schedules' prior-year columns (130, 128, 119), which put 2016 on the basis of the 2016Q4 schedule: 130+128+119+123 = 500, its stated twelve months. (3) ERLEADA was inside the line in 2018 (J&J's 2020Q1 schedule footnote: 'ERLEADA was previously included in Other Oncology'; the 2018 schedules print no ERLEADA line), so the 2018 rows include it. Annual checks against each Q4 schedule's twelve-month figure: 2013 415, 2014 602, 2015 442, 2016 500, 2017 504, 2018 590, each equal to the sum of the four rows. Before this line J&J printed DOXIL/CAELYX WW itself (the gold series 2010Q1-2012Q4); the 2012Q1 exhibit prints OTHER ONCOLOGY WW 19 and DOXIL/CAELYX WW 24, and the 2013Q1 exhibit restates 2012Q1 OTHER ONCOLOGY WW to 43 = 19 + 24. 2013Q1-2014Q3 are read from the 8-K exhibit 99.2 schedules; 2014Q4 on from the investor-site PDFs. 2015Q3 is read from the 2016Q3 schedule's prior-year column because the 2015Q3 PDF text splits its digits. line_includes holds only the name an issuer footnote states (Erleada); Imbruvica and Darzalex, inferred from restated comparative columns, are in continuation.line_includes_inferred_not_footnoted. Presence of DOXIL/CAELYX in the line is documented in J&J text only for 2013 (Form 10-Qs for 2013Q1 and 2013Q2, and the FY2013 Form 10-K Exhibit 13 MD&A); no J&J 10-Q or 10-K text checked for 2013Q3-2018 names the product, so the 2014Q1-2018Q4 rows rest on J&J still holding the product until Baxter's 2019 acquisition. Doxil sales after 2018Q4 (Baxter's US transfer in 2019 and ex-US transfer in 2021) are not carried; Baxter's later Doxil figures were checked only as acquisition-note disclosures, with no continuous net-sales line.
search_log: Reused the J&J investor-site quarterly schedule PDFs 2014Q3-2026Q2 already downloaded for the sibling J&J manifests (48 files; 2023Q2 downloaded again from its sibling-manifest URL) and extracted every page with pdfplumber into text; searched all 49 documents case-insensitively for the product names (counts reported per product below).

Fetched each J&J schedule row from the document's own text: the first occurrence of the line's name line followed by its WW row (the main Reported Sales vs. Prior Period table, ahead of any supplemental table).

Searched all 49 schedule PDFs for DOXIL and CAELYX: 0 occurrences. The only J&J place the product is named after 2012Q4 is prose (2013Q1 Form 10-Q: 'Other Oncology increased, primarily due to DOXIL/CAELYX'; also the 2013Q2 10-Q).

Downloaded the 2013Q1-2014Q3 8-K exhibit 99.2 schedules (the URLs of the sibling PREZISTA manifest) and read the OTHER ONCOLOGY WW rows; every 2013 and 2014 quarter ties to the twelve-month figure of the Q4 document (415 and 602).

Fetched Baxter International (CIK 10456) Forms 10-K FY2019-FY2023 and 10-Q 2021Q1 and searched for Doxil: acquisition notes only (U.S. rights acquired in 2019; ex-U.S. rights 2021-02-17); no continuous Baxter net-sales line for Doxil, so Baxter is not a successor_issuer line (the sibling gold manifest records its partial 2021 acquisition-note figures).

Fetched J&J Forms 10-K/10-Q filed 2019-02 to 2021-04 (9 documents) and searched for DOXIL/CAELYX: 0 text hits through 2020-10; the FY2020 10-K and 2021Q1 10-Q carry only the XBRL member 'EvraAndDoxilMember' (subsequent event dated 2021-01).
Bigdata.com search was unavailable (credits exhausted); documents located from the local caches and EDGAR.

continuation.evidence: J&J Form 8-K exhibit 99.2 for the first quarter of 2013 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040613000050/a1q20138kexhibit992o.htm): the Oncology block lists VELCADE, ZYTIGA and OTHER ONCOLOGY and no DOXIL/CAELYX line; OTHER ONCOLOGY WW 97 | 43, where the first-quarter 2012 exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040612000061/a1q20128-kexhibit992o.htm) printed OTHER ONCOLOGY WW 19 and DOXIL/CAELYX WW 24 (19 + 24 = 43); footnote (4) 'Prior year amounts have been reclassified to conform to current year product disclosure'. The first-quarter 2013 Form 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040613000057/a1q10q3-31x13.htm) says 'Other Oncology increased, primarily due to DOXIL/CAELYX'.

line_includes_basis.Erleada: footnoted: J&J 1Q2020 Sales of Key Products/Franchises schedule, footnote '(2) ERLEADA was previously included in Other Oncology'.

line_includes_inferred_not_footnoted.Imbruvica: inferred from restated comparatives, not footnoted: the 1Q2015 schedule restates 2014Q1 OTHER ONCOLOGY WW from the 102 first printed to 92, the difference being the 10 printed for IMBRUVICA's prior-year quarter on the same schedule; no footnote states the earlier inclusion.
line_includes_inferred_not_footnoted.Darzalex: inferred from restated comparatives, not footnoted: the 4Q2016 schedule restates 2015Q4 OTHER ONCOLOGY WW from the 136 first printed to 116, the difference being the 20 printed for DARZALEX's prior-year quarter; no footnote states the earlier inclusion.
